item.title: Axsome Auvelity FDA Approval for Alzheimer's Agitation
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA approved Axsome Therapeutics' Auvelity (dextromethorphan/bupropion) for the treatment of agitation associated with Alzheimer's disease. This is the first non-antipsychotic drug approved for Alzheimer's agitation, offering a new option for a condition often treated off-label with antipsychotics. The approval was supported by data from the ADVANCE-1 and other trials showing significant reduction in agitation symptoms. Auvelity previously received approval for major depressive disorder. The Alzheimer's label is expected to significantly expand the drug's market.
  • MoAs: Dextromethorphan: NMDA receptor antagonist and sigma-1 receptor agonist; Bupropion: norepinephrine and dopamine reuptake inhibitor
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, STAT News, BioSpace

item.title: Corcept ALS Drug Data
item.description:
• Summary: Corcept Therapeutics reported improved two-year survival data for its investigational ALS drug, signaling potential efficacy in this devastating neurodegenerative disease. The company is nearing initiation of a Phase 3 trial based on these promising results.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace
